objective_value: <float> Total cost of the solution, equal to the sum of routing cost over all traversed arcs and inconvenience cost over all customers.
routes: <list[list[int]]> Ordered sequence of vertex indices visited by each used vehicle, beginning at the start depot (0) and ending at the return depot (num_customers+1).
schedule: <dict, key: '{customer_id}'> Service start time at each customer.
